The '''Sulphur Hills''' were a hilly region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sulphur Hills are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" /> Its name uses the traditionally British spelling despite the adjacent [[Sulfur Lake]] using the traditionally American spelling.
